page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance is equipped with 3839 GB of bundled local SSD storage, making it suitable for applications requiring high-capacity local data access. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 40 Gbps. No GPUs are included in this configuration, and it does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The combination of dedicated Intel Xeon processing, a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, and substantial local SSD storage positions this instance for storage-intensive and database workloads. It is well-suited for relational databases, NoSQL databases, caching layers, and data processing tasks that benefit from high-speed local storage and high network throughput.
